entries.author: lsa
entries.body:
That sort gotcha is nasty, thanks for naming it. I spent an evening last month convinced my account had a problem because a table query kept returning stuff I "knew" was outdated. It was me feeding the API parameters it never read, and the oldest rows happened to tell the story I already believed. Never again without a control query.

The id thing too. Copying a working third-party op character for character before your own first broadcast is the cheapest insurance there is on these sidechains. Most of the "my tokens vanished" posts I see are really "my op was mined but never applied" posts, and nobody on either side noticed the difference. Bookmarking this checklist.

entries.author: wic
entries.body:
Alba Rosa's Dream explores themes of beauty, resilience, and the cyclical nature of life. The song aims to evoke a sense of wonder and appreciation for nature's fleeting moments. The choice of words reflects admiration for the delicate and pure qualities of the Alba Rosa flower, drawing parallels between its life cycle and the various phases of human experience.

The verses paint a vivid picture of the flower's presence in different times—morning, night, and through the changing seasons. The chorus emphasizes the dance of the Alba Rosa, symbolizing the joy and grace found in embracing life's rhythmic patterns.

The title, "Alba Rosa's Dream," suggests a narrative or story belonging to the flower, as if it dreams through its existence. This adds a touch of whimsy and invites listeners to contemplate the deeper meanings hidden within the natural world.

Overall, the song seeks to convey a sense of awe, respect, and interconnectedness with the beauty of nature, inviting the listener to reflect on their own journey through life's fleeting moments.
